notes: Chain registry for services/chain-query and the console's 'Blockchain queries' twisty (DESIGN/xrplh-28). Committed: endpoints, capabilities and contract sources only; never the user's addresses, keys or seeds (those live in config/local/chain-profile.json and C:\PRIV-AI-SECRETS\chainaim.env). Every endpoint below was read from the official docs on 2026-11-03 (see each 'sourceUrl'). Values written as "<PLACEHOLDER: ...>" are not known yet; chain-query --validate reports them and the UI greys out a source that has one. 'capabilities' says what the UI may offer; 'amendmentStatus' records what the docs said, and chain-query re-checks the live network at start-up instead of trusting this file.

units.rate: 1/10 basis point (1 = 0.001 %, 100000 = 100 %) per XLS-66 §3.2.2 / §3.8.1, as in CreditSeal packages/xls66/src/units.ts
units.time: seconds; ledger timestamps are Ripple-epoch seconds

ledgerEntries.notes: Field names as read by CreditSeal services/lending/src/ledger.ts (vaultView, brokerView, loanView). That code reads entries by ID (ledger_entry index) after creating them; discovering entries by owner (account_objects with a vault/loan_broker type filter) is not verified yet.
